And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description – Senior PIM Developer With Commerce Integration Expertise**
**Experience: Min 5 years of hands\-on experience**
**Role Summary**
 The Senior PIM Developer will design, implement, and maintain Product Information Management solutions with a focus on product data governance, catalog enrichment, and seamless integration with Commerce platforms (Adobe Commerce / VTEX), ERP, OMS, and other enterprise systems. The role requires deep expertise in PIM tools, data modeling, and multi\-channel product syndication.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and configure PIM data models including product attributes, attribute sets, families, categories, and taxonomy structures.
* Implement and maintain PIM platforms (Akeneo, InRiver, Salsify) including workflows, rules, and data quality checks.
* Integrate PIM with downstream systems — Commerce platforms (Adobe Commerce / VTEX), ERP, OMS, CMS, and DAM — via REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, or ETL pipelines.
* Govern product data quality — define completeness rules, validation workflows, and enrichment processes.
* Manage multi\-channel catalog publishing — map and syndicate product data to various channels (web, print, marketplaces).
* Optimize data synchronization pipelines for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Troubleshoot data discrepancies, sync failures, and production issues with timely resolution.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to data governance and integration design decisions.
* Perform code and configuration reviews and mentor junior developers.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Data Stewards, Architects, QA, and business stakeholders in Agile environments.


**Qualifications**
**Must Have**
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one PIM platform: Akeneo, InRiver, Salsify, or equivalent.
* Deep understanding of product data modeling — attribute families, completeness metrics, variant/SKU hierarchies, and category trees.
* Experience building PIM\-to\-Commerce integrations (Adobe Commerce, VTEX, Salesforce Commerce, etc.).
* Proficiency with REST / GraphQL APIs for data ingestion and syndication.
* Experience with ERP integration (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) for pricing, inventory, and product master data.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with catalog APIs or Adobe Commerce catalog modules.
* Knowledge of DAM systems and media asset enrichment workflows.
* Familiarity with ETL tools (MuleSoft, Boomi).
* Understanding of B2B catalog scenarios: customer\-specific pricing, entitlements, and product visibility rules.
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and MDM concepts.


**Key Differentiators for This Role**
* PIM platform configuration and administration not just integration.
* Ownership of product data quality and enrichment workflows end\-to\-end.
* Ability to bridge business/merchandising teams and technical engineering teams.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
